dct_description_sm: This data set was constructed to measure carbon dioxide fluxes from the surface water of the Mackenzie River and estuary.  The data are to be used in conjunction with the climate data from the Environment Canada Inuvik and Tuktoyaktuk climate stations in the application of the thin boundary layer model to determine gas fluxes, and to determine net phototrophy or heterotrophy in these waters.
dct_title_s: pCO2 transect in the Mackenzie River and Beaufort Sea (ARDEX)
